issues.claim: Source citation for section 3: https://www.gainescpacfo.com/our-accounting-services.htm is described as a 'service list including tax planning and tax preparation'.
issues.problem: Re-opened the page. Its service sections are Accounting and Bookkeeping, Financial Services, Payroll, QuickBooks, and Estate and Trust Planning. Tax planning and tax preparation appear only in the site-wide Tax Services navigation/footer, not in that page's service list. The underlying business claim is true (dedicated tax pages exist), but the cited URL does not support it as described.
issues.fix: Cite https://www.gainescpacfo.com/tax-planning-services.htm and https://www.gainescpacfo.com/income-tax-preparation-services.htm for the tax claim, or say 'the site's Tax Services menu lists tax planning and tax preparation'.

issues.claim: 'Several lines are sold as recurring monthly services' and 'Payroll, AP/AR, reconciliations and month-end close are offered as recurring monthly services'.
issues.problem: The outsourced-accounting page lists payroll processing, AP/AR, credit-card and bank reconciliations and month-end closings, and describes ongoing outsourcing, but publishes no engagement cadence or pricing. 'Recurring monthly' is an inference; payroll recurs per pay cycle, not monthly. It is presented as fact in the intro and section 1 'Now' without an inference label.
issues.fix: Soften to 'offered as ongoing outsourced services, including month-end closings' or add '(our inference from the service list)' and keep 'monthly' tied to month-end close and reconciliations.

issues.claim: Section 2 impact: 78-156 triage hours valued at $60.59/hour (accountants and auditors median, NJ, 2025, x1.25).
issues.problem: The work described - answering the form, callbacks and consult triage - is typically administrative/front-desk. Section 1 explicitly labels the accountant grade as an assumption; section 2 does not, so the dollar range may be roughly double an administrative-rate estimate. Hours and arithmetic are correct; the rate grade is unlabeled.
issues.fix: Value section 2 at an administrative/office-support benchmark, or add 'grade choice our assumption' and state that the range is illustrative.

issues.claim: BLS source URLs https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUS340000000000013201113 and https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUS340000000000013208213 support the two medians.
issues.problem: Both endpoints returned 'REQUEST_NOT_PROCESSED - daily threshold ... reached' when re-opened, so the audit's own links currently show an error to the founder. The values are correct: $100,830 ($48.48/hour) and $43,420 ($20.88/hour), May 2025 New Jersey, confirmed through a BLS OEWS-derived mirror.
issues.fix: Keep the values but add a human-readable BLS OEWS state page (or the mirror used, https://fedsalary.com/us/jobs/accountants-and-auditors/new-jersey/ and https://fedsalary.com/us/jobs/tax-preparers/new-jersey/) and retain the note to re-check before quoting.

issues.claim: 'You run an Edison CPA firm that leads with virtual CFO and outsourced accounting...'
issues.problem: The homepage leads with virtual CFO and business turnaround services and lists outsourced accounting as one CFO service line. Calling outsourced accounting a lead positioning slightly overstates the site's emphasis. Minor characterization, not a hard factual error.
issues.fix: Say 'leads with virtual CFO work, including outsourced accounting' to match the homepage.

claims_checked.claim: Gaines & Associates, PC is an Edison, NJ CPA firm at 105 Fieldcrest Ave, Suite 501, Edison, NJ 08837; phone 732-906-9277.
Firm leads with virtual CFO work and offers outsourced accounting and tax services.
Payroll, AP/AR, credit-card/bank reconciliations and month-end closings are listed as outsourced services.
Those services are sold as 'recurring monthly' services.
Clients send documents through a secure file link (ProtectedXchange) in the site header.
The consultation page is a form with no calendar or qualifying questions.
A free initial consultation is offered.
Service pages list tax planning and tax preparation.
our-accounting-services.htm's service list includes tax planning and tax preparation.
QuickBooks is a service line.
The firm serves clients nationwide.
BLS API series OEUS340000000000013201113 returns the New Jersey accountants and auditors median.
New Jersey accountants and auditors median is $100,830 (May 2025), $48.48/hour, $60.59/hour at x1.25.
BLS API series OEUS340000000000013208213 returns the New Jersey tax preparers median.
New Jersey tax preparers median is $43,420 (May 2025), $20.88/hour, $26.09/hour at x1.25.
Section 1 arithmetic: 25-40 books x 12 closes x 1.5-3 hours x 50% = 225-720 hours; x $60.59 = $13,600-$43,600.
Section 2 arithmetic: 52 weeks x 3-6 hours x 50% = 78-156 hours; x $60.59 = $4,700-$9,400.
Section 3 arithmetic: 3-5 staff x 500 hours x 10%-20% = 150-500 hours; x $26.09 = $3,900-$13,000.
Audit body is at most about 450 words.
For-the-founder email/opener: three opportunities, estimates labeled, 20-minute walkthrough, small paid pilot; no unsupported business claims.
Privacy and compliance: no personal data on private individuals, no home addresses or personal phone numbers, public sources only.
Tone is respectful, non-alarmist and free of implied insider knowledge; business name and town are correct.
